description_en: Retrieves basic information and source file information for multiple media assets
description_zh: 批量获取媒资基础信息和源文件信息
name: BatchGetMediaInfos

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the media asset, which is the audio or video ID (VideoId). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs. You can obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- For audio or video files uploaded in the console, log on to the VOD console and choose Media Assets > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.

- The value of the VideoId parameter that is returned after you call the operation to obtain an upload URL and credential.

- The value of the VideoId parameter that is returned after you call the SearchMedia operation.
parameters.description_zh:
媒资ID，即音/视频ID（VideoId）。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。可通过以下方式获取：

- 通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
- 通过获取音视频上传地址和凭证接口获取上传地址和凭证时，为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音/视频上传后，可通过搜索媒体信息接口查询，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
